caption: The drawing features a rectangular swatch of woven textile centered on a plain, off-white background. The textile sample consists of repeating vertical stripes in an alternating color pattern. The colors used in the stripes include dark brown, deep blue, a muted olive green, a soft gray, and a rusty orange. Each stripe is composed of a series of small, rounded segments forming a scalloped or beaded effect along the length of the stripe. The colors are evenly spaced and the pattern is consistent across the entire rectangle. In the lower right quadrant of the image, below the textile swatch and to the right, is the name "Mary C. Davidson" written in small, light-colored text. There are no other objects or designs on the background.
title: Woven Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
